title: Collaboration setup
intro: Share a Webcraft workspace for live viewing, comments, and chat; your Agent conversation stays private.

descriptions.lan: Start here when everyone is on the same Wi-Fi or local network; no cloudflared installation is needed.
descriptions.temporary: Use a free temporary internet address without a domain or Cloudflare account; the address changes when public access restarts.
descriptions.named: Use a stable HTTPS address on a domain you manage in Cloudflare; you need a Cloudflare account and a named Tunnel.

hostname_error: Enter a hostname or HTTPS origin without a port, path, credentials, query, or invitation.

lan: Open a Project, then open a Webcraft Session in that Project.
Select Collaborate → Project, enter your name, and choose Create collaboration with Local network selected.
Select Share this workspace for the site or content set you want visitors to see.
Open Links, create a Comment & chat invitation, and copy its Local network link.
Ask your visitor to open the invitation in a browser on the same network and enter their name; try a comment and a chat message.
temporary: Open a Project and a Webcraft Session, then select Collaborate → Project and create collaboration with Local network selected.
Check cloudflared; if missing, use the setup request to install it, then select Check again before enabling public access.
Share this workspace, then use Public access → Free temporary address → Enable public access.
Wait for public access to become Active, then open Links and create a Comment & chat invitation using its Internet entry.
Ask your visitor to open the invitation in a browser on another network and try a comment and a chat message.
named: Open a Project and a Webcraft Session, then select Collaborate → Project and create collaboration with Local network selected.
Use the setup request to install cloudflared, create a named Tunnel, and create the hostname’s DNS route to that Tunnel in Cloudflare.
Share this workspace, then choose Public access → Your own Tunnel.
Fill in all three fields: your HTTPS public URL, the Tunnel UUID, and the absolute path to its local credentials JSON file; then Enable public access.
When Active, open Links, create a Comment & chat invitation, choose its Internet entry, and send it to your visitor.
Ask your visitor to open the invitation in a browser on another network and try a comment and a chat message.

keep_online: Keep the host computer, Pneuma, and the sharing Session tab online while visitors use the workspace.
public_lifecycle: Public access stops after 10 minutes without an authenticated public visitor and starts off after a restart; enable it again when needed.
check_error: Could not read setup status. Check again to prepare the setup request.
cloudflared_missing: cloudflared not found on this computer
install_hint: The setup request can install cloudflared for this computer; checking never changes your configuration.
paste_hint: Paste this one-sentence request into Claude Code or Codex on this computer to perform and verify setup.
copy_error: Copy failed. The request is selected below; copy it manually.
request_label: Setup request for Claude Code or Codex
advanced_title: Advanced: use a self-hosted cloud authority
advanced_body: Cloud host connects to a collaboration authority you deploy and manage yourself using the repository’s cloud/collaboration deployment instructions; it requires its HTTPS URL and provisioning key and does not create a hosted service account. Workspace content still depends on its host and Session staying online.

request_paths.temporary: temporary internet collaboration using a free Cloudflare Quick Tunnel
request_paths.named: internet collaboration using my own domain and a named Cloudflare Tunnel

request_missing.named: Project, domain, or Cloudflare account details

request: Configure and verify {{scenario}}{{hostnameClause}} for Pneuma Skills {{appVersion}} on {{platform}} by reading the complete local setup guide at {{guidePath}} (if unavailable, fetch {{guideUrl}} from this running private Pneuma app), ask me for any missing {{missing}}, then execute the setup and verify the visitor browser can open the shared Webcraft workspace and use Comment & chat while keeping my Agent conversation private.
lan_ready: No tunnel is needed for same-network collaboration.
public_recovery: If public access fails, fix the reported cause, select Retry stopping public access to clear the failed attempt, then Enable public access again; Check again only checks installation.
